suggestions.roleTitleVi: Chủ cơ sở May thủ công và Thiết kế theo yêu cầu
suggestions.reasoning: Drawing on findings from Stanford HAI (2024) and NBER, automation and AI primarily impact digital and structured processes while physical craft, manual dexterity, and bespoke personalized creation retain strong human advantages. Transitioning to small-scale entrepreneurship leverages existing industrial garment skills while adapting to niche craft interests.
suggestions.whyItFitsYou: Your 8 years of industrial garment experience, technical drawing interpretation, and quality inspection skills combined with your interests in small-scale business and craft perfectly position you to build a specialized local brand with low initial financial risk.

trajectories.actionStepNow: Talk to line managers about digital QC software training programs.
